notes.hook: The premise of NASA funding a Russian ghost module catches interest immediately.
notes.clarity: The timeline from launch to docking to crew arrival is easy to follow in order.
notes.payoff: Revealing how long the core module floated empty before life support arrived pays off the setup well.
notes.visuals: Every shot features real, high-quality historical photography of the actual Zarya assembly mission.
notes.loop: The closing line about stepping inside the foundation flows naturally back into the opening hook.

rounds.better_than_last: It uses authentic historical mission photos for every beat of the assembly sequence rather than relying on generic renders.
